newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones derivatives trade seen starting Oct 6.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones derivatives trade seen starting Oct 6.

text.p: Trading in futures and options on the Dow Jones Industrial Average is expected to begin Monday, October 6, industry sources said Tuesday.
The Chicago Board of Trade will trade the futures and the Chicago Board Options Exchange will trade the options.
"October 6 is the date everybody is shooting for," one industry source said, adding that the launch was pending regulatory approval of the products.
A spokesman at the CBOT said the exchange had not decided on a launch date. The CBOE declined to comment.
In early June, Dow Jones & Co licensed the CBOT, the CBOE and the American Stock Exchange to trade investment products on the Dow industrials.
